scenes.headline: How a 594B model runs on 17B
scenes.sub: Inkling 2 Small: experts, phases and the compute that adds up.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cuttle! Inkling 2 Small is a new mixture of experts from Thinking Machines. It holds five hundred ninety-four billion parameters and uses seventeen billion per token.

scenes.text: Almost every parameter lives in routed experts, and each token wakes only 8 of 384 in every layer.
scenes.say: The idea: almost every parameter lives in routed experts, and each token wakes only eight of three hundred eighty-four in every layer.

steps.label: 384 experts
steps.say: Picture one layer's experts as a grid. All of them sit in memory.

steps.label: 8 picked
steps.say: A router looks at the token and picks eight. Only those eight do any work for it.

scenes.title: What two counts pin down
scenes.text: total - active = layers x (n - k) x E

parts.say: Subtract the active count from the total. Attention and embeddings cancel, because they are in both.
What is left is only the experts a token skips.
Solve it, and the routed experts come to almost all of the model.

items.say: Phase one is eight point four trillion tokens of text, code and images, in sixty-eight hours.
Phase two adds newer, higher quality data at long context.
Then reasoning and agent trajectories, filtered for correctness.
Finally one joint reinforcement learning run, on two thousand and forty-eight GPUs for nine days.

scenes.label: learner + sampler FLOPs for the RL run, from 8ND
scenes.say: Count each RL token as sampled, then trained. Eight times seventeen billion times three trillion matches the post's own compute figure.

scenes.text: The training numbers add up; the benchmarks stay reported until the weights ship.
scenes.say: The training numbers add up. The benchmarks stay the lab's own until the weights ship.
Eight of three hundred eighty-four experts. Almost everything routed. And compute that checks out.
